fit.optimizer: fresh Adam for each failed candidate
fit.loss: L_v2_regression + 0.1 * mean(two component sign losses). At all train starts, r_c=V_c-z/550 and r_h=V_h; targets use the unchanged common stop. For each component with abs(target)<=0.05, use (relu(min(abs(target),0.01)-sign(target)*prediction)/0.01)^2. For exact zero targets use (relu(prediction)/0.01)^2. A component with no selected starts contributes zero. Selection uses target values only. Exact original targets incur zero sign loss.
fit.checkpoint_rule: Check update 0; preserve passing source tensors. Only the two named failed candidates may update. Check every 10, freeze first train pass; retain final failed checkpoint at 300. No quota transfer, resume, repeated attempt, or development-based choice.

train_gate.recognition_rule: Accept every actually feasible primary start and reject every actually infeasible start across all five budgets. Report actual fixed-policy outcomes separately; the full_s2 timeout must be rejected. False-infeasible counts outside the primary budget remain diagnostics as in v2, not a new hidden perfect-recognition requirement.
train_gate.error_criteria: unchanged relative MAE<=0.35 and variance-conditional Pearson>=0.70, variance ratio 0.50

development_gate: Freeze all six checkpoints after all six train gates pass; call the original evaluator once on the same 180 saved development trajectories. Original primary 6/6 per candidate, zero false-feasible, beta=0 and error criteria remain unchanged. Only original G4 checks may release a bundle.
failure_policy: Any train failure blocks development. Development failure retains FAIL with no retry or automatic extra updates. Preserve all journals, models and old attempts.
protected: common stop and original value targets
fixed complete v2 controller and calibration
maps, budgets, timing, splits and final data seals
read-only RC-PPO, HiRA, manuscripts and all prior artifacts
